name: tracechain
description: Blockchain-based supply chain traceability system with SSI credential verification

scripts.predev: npm run build --workspace @tracechain/shared && npm run build --workspace @tracechain/ssi
scripts.dev: concurrently --names web,api --prefix-colors cyan,green "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.dev:seed-custody-transfer: npm run build --workspace @tracechain/shared && npm run dev:seed-custody-transfer --workspace @tracechain/contracts
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @tracechain/shared && npm run build --workspace @tracechain/ssi && npm run build --workspace @tracechain/api && npm run build --workspace @tracechain/web
scripts.test:auth: npm run build --workspace @tracechain/shared && npm run build --workspace @tracechain/ssi && npm run test:auth --workspace @tracechain/api
scripts.test:blockchain: npm run build --workspace @tracechain/shared && npm run test:blockchain --workspace @tracechain/api
scripts.test:ssi-api: npm run build --workspace @tracechain/shared && npm run build --workspace @tracechain/ssi && npm run test:ssi-api --workspace @tracechain/api
scripts.test:ssi: npm run build --workspace @tracechain/shared && npm run test:ssi --workspace @tracechain/ssi
scripts.test:custody-transfers: npm run build --workspace @tracechain/shared && npm run build --workspace @tracechain/ssi && npm run test:custody-transfers --workspace @tracechain/api
scripts.test:ingredient-batches: npm run build --workspace @tracechain/shared && npm run build --workspace @tracechain/ssi && npm run test:ingredient-batches --workspace @tracechain/api
scripts.test:production-flow: npm run build --workspace @tracechain/shared && npm run build --workspace @tracechain/ssi && npm run test:production-flow --workspace @tracechain/api
scripts.test:product-traceability: npm run build --workspace @tracechain/shared && npm run test:product-traceability --workspace @tracechain/api
scripts.test:stakeholder-directory: npm run build --workspace @tracechain/shared && npm run test:stakeholder-directory --workspace @tracechain/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @tracechain/shared && npm run build --workspace @tracechain/ssi && npm run typecheck --workspace @tracechain/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @tracechain/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @tracechain/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @tracechain/ssi && npm run typecheck --workspace @tracechain/contracts
